label: Total super balance limit for carrying forward unused concessional cap
quote: From 1 July 2018, if you have a total superannuation balance of less than $500,000 on 30 June of the previous financial year, you may be entitled to contribute more than the general concessional contributions cap
pattern: total superannuation balance of less than (\$[\d,]+) on 30 June of the previous financial year

legislation.application: Treasury Laws Amendment (Fair and Sustainable Superannuation) Act 2016 (No. 81, 2016) Sch 6 item 4 inserted it and item 5 sets that application

notes: The balance must be below this amount on 30 June of the previous financial year. The page's 1 July 2018 is when unused cap amounts begin: ITAA 1997 s 291-20(7) gives no unused concessional contributions cap for a financial year earlier than 2018-19, so amounts unused from 2018-19 onward can be carried forward. The $500,000 test in s 291-20(3)(b), on the total superannuation balance just before the start of the financial year, applies in working out the cap for the 2019-20 financial year and later years: Treasury Laws Amendment (Fair and Sustainable Superannuation) Act 2016 (No. 81, 2016) Sch 6 item 4 inserted it and item 5 sets that application; Sch 6 commenced on 1 January 2017: https://www.legislation.gov.au/C2016A00081/asmade
